heritage.text:
Since 1862,

Maison Ladurée has embodied indulgence in the French art of living. An iconic institution, it meets each day with excellence the challenge of marrying tradition and innovation in its creations.

tradition.title:
TRADITION,

MEMORY & AUDACITY,

SINCE 1862
tradition.label: savoir-faire
tradition.text: Our ranges reflect our ambition: to offer a sensory pleasure based on taste, visual and olfactory sensations that plunge into the memory of childhood and tradition. Our creations recreate a world of softness, affection and indulgence. Our creativity, rooted in the present, clothes them in timelessness.
tradition.alt: An illustrated box of Ladurée macarons
